build_collective_reward_wrapper: build a python module that wraps a dm_env environment with CollectiveRewardWrapper to add collective reward observations
create_wrapper_init: create a CollectiveRewardWrapper instance by passing a dm_env environment to its constructor
test_get_timestep: test the _get_timestep method to verify it augments observations with the sum of all player rewards
review_reset_step: review the reset and step methods to understand how they delegate to the wrapped environment and augment timesteps
summarize_observation_spec: summarize the observation_spec method that adds a COLLECTIVE_REWARD scalar field to each agent's observation space
